Rewritten BOM-less. The new-task skill warned about this for usage.json only; the warning now covers every file it writes.

assign.now: Ruler rebuilt as one row at one scale; detail dial, 9 presets, Words tab and syntax note all live — verifying at four widths

log.msg: The detail dial shipped as a CAP (detail bounded a random region count) and on seed 7 step 4 had nothing to allow — the dial moved, the layout did not. Rebuilt so each step is a GUARANTEE: the seed carries the variety, the dial only elaborates. gen.js now draws everything up front and gates only what is printed, so a step up adds a region to the SAME layout instead of teleporting.

Two of my own ext/LayoutTool markers were the findings, not the layouts. On words/ the wall carried data-layout-ignore, which hid the cards real text too and read as one 625px gap — rhythm at HIGH. On space/ only the screens were marked, leaving the row itself a 2986x579 box holding 51 characters — empty at HIGH. The rule: mark the box whose CONTENTS are unmeasurable, and no box that also holds real text. Also caught .grid.auto stretching a four-card family across eleven tracks at 3440 (auto-fit + unbounded 1fr), the trap the layout-design skill names; space-words uses auto-fill with a 22em ceiling.

assign.outcome:
**The ruler is one row at one scale** — /framework/styles/layouts/space/ · [Words](/framework/styles/layouts/space/words/) · [Syntax](/framework/styles/layouts/space/docs/syntax/)

Controls moved above (textarea, seed stepper, detail dial, nine presets); the five screens now sit in a single non-wrapping row at ONE zoom, so a card 200px wide on the 1280 screen is 200px wide on the 3440 one. Per-shot fitting was the bug behind "they are not all visible at once".

New: a **detail dial** (gen(seed, detail), five steps, each a guarantee rather than a cap); **nine presets** where there were four, every name a real directory in the rail (document, shell, split, dashboard, masonry added; wall renamed gallery); a **Words** tab — 35 cards, every word the format accepts with a live picture drawn from a spec; and a **Syntax** note holding the grammar.
